people.name: Hazzelelponi
people.line: A woman mentioned in the genealogy of Judah.

people.name: Ishma
people.line: Son of Hur, descendant of Judah.

people.name: Jezreel
people.line: A son of Hur in the genealogy of Judah

translations.web: These were the sons of the father of Etam: Jezreel, Ishma, and Idbash. The name of their sister was Hazzelelponi.
translations.bsb: These were the sons of Etam: Jezreel, Ishma, and Idbash. And their sister was named Hazzelelponi.
